references.title: Kongsberg Gruppen
references.note: The article on the successor company states that Kongsberg is a continuation of Kongsberg Vapenfabrikk, 1814 to 1987.

logo.alt: The Kongsberg mark: a crowned royal monogram in gold on a red panel, with KONGSBERG in blue capitals beneath.
logo.caption: The mark of Kongsberg Gruppen, the group the arms factory became. The crowned monogram is the royal cypher the works has carried since 1814.
